contradictions.claimA: The invading army numbered ninety-four thousand (as rendered in the Indonesian text)
contradictions.resolution: The 'ninety-four thousand' rendering (v13.txt:7057, 18347) is a translation slip: 940,000 is stated outright elsewhere (v13.txt:16208; v14.txt:1124, 4650, 10133).
contradictions.treatment: Adopted 940,000 as EXPLICIT on F-EMP-010 (R5). The component sum 700,000 + 200,000 + 40,000 is kept only as a cross-check.

contradictions.claimA: No prisoners were taken; all were killed in action
contradictions.claimB: Captured imperial forces were returned to the Empire
contradictions.resolution: Not a contradiction: no prisoners were taken in the surface battle. The later prisoners are the ~700,000 resurrected soldiers (v14.txt:875; v16.txt:7992), held in Tempest until the repatriation.
contradictions.treatment: CAS-008 restates pow = 0 for the surface phase; CAS-014 records pow ~700,000 at the resurrection; CAS-021 records the revival. Killed, revived and captured are separate columns.

contradictions.description: Whether Shion and others died in the sealed space (resolved: misreading)
contradictions.claimA: Pre-R5 dataset: Shion and others are killed in the sealed space (EVT-0362, CAS-013, ACT-011)
contradictions.claimB: V15 Ch2 opens with Rimuru recalling the earlier time Shion and others were killed (the pre-war massacre) and saying this time is different; Shion fights right after and Benimaru says all are safe
contradictions.resolution: The cited line is a flashback, not a death in this war. No Tempest death is narrated in the long night.
contradictions.treatment: R5: CAS-013 deleted; EVT-0362 to be deleted by the phase editor; ACT-011 set to ACTIVE; CAS-026 records zero Tempest deaths for the long night (qualitative).

contradictions.claimA: A force of one hundred thirteen thousand could be sent on the emperor's order
contradictions.claimB: The legions described immediately before total far more than 113,000
contradictions.resolution: Internally inconsistent within a single passage. Possibly 1,130,000 mis-rendered, or a first-wave echelon.
contradictions.treatment: Excluded from the force database. Recorded here and in AMB-002 only.

contradictions.description: Total imperial strength implied by the 70 percent figure
contradictions.claimA: The 700,000 entering the forest is about seventy percent of the whole imperial strength, implying roughly 1,000,000 total
contradictions.claimB: The Empire can mobilise more than two million including garrisons
contradictions.resolution: Reconcilable: '70% of all imperial strength' is measured against the Armored Division's deployable ceiling (~1,000,000), which V12 Ch4 states for that legion, not for the whole Empire.
contradictions.treatment: F-EMP-001 (Armored Division deployable ceiling) is the denominator. F-EMP-000 (whole Empire) has no stated total.

contradictions.description: When the Dwargon eastern blockade begins
contradictions.claimA: Gazel reports the eastern gate already blockaded, before first contact
contradictions.claimB: The blockade camp scene is narrated in V14, after the Jura campaign
contradictions.resolution: The blockade is in place before first contact (reported in the D+0 Gazel call) and persists to V14 Ch4; its start date is not stated.
contradictions.treatment: R5: EVT-0016 (Gazel reports the blockade) at D+0; blockade start RECONSTRUCTED between the council tasking (V12 Ch4) and D+0 (MOV-008). The old D-6 note was inconsistent with EVT-0016 and is withdrawn.

contradictions.description: What the 'month' and 'twenty-nine day' anchors are measured from
contradictions.claimA: A month has passed since the subordinates' gathering met (V13 Ch1 opening line)
contradictions.claimB: The chariot force was expected in about twenty-nine days or more, but the invasion was slower than expected
contradictions.resolution: Both anchors are measured from the V12 Ch5 Control Room war council (v12.txt:12108), not the V12 Ch2 office meeting. At that council the forecast was ~20 days (v12.txt:12444-12449); V13 Ch1 recalls ~29 days or more and says the advance was slower still.
contradictions.treatment: R5: war council (the gathering) = D-33; month mark = D-3 (CANONICAL_RELATIVE, 30 days); halt D-2; first contact D+0 = 33 days after the gathering, slower than both forecasts. See AMB-016.

contradictions.claimA: Revision brief: Gradim killed by Vega
contradictions.claimB: Carillon ('Carrion') attacks Gradim as he falls into his awakening sleep and he dies; Vega then devours his head and body
contradictions.resolution: The text gives the kill to Carillon; Vega only devours the remains.
contradictions.treatment: CMD-035 / ACT-035 / CAS-025: killed by Carillon, remains devoured by Vega.

contradictions.claimB: The masked Marshal at the V12 Ch4 council is Caligulio's superior and is revealed as Velgrynd
contradictions.resolution: Caligulio is one of the Three Great Generals; Velgrynd is the Marshal.
contradictions.treatment: Renamed CMD-031/ACT-031 to General Caligulio; CMD-038/ACT-039 start at the V12 Ch4 council.

contradictions.claimA: V12 Ch2: number unknown, 'I don't think more than a thousand'
contradictions.claimB: V13 Ch4: 'ten thousand in all', B+
contradictions.sourceB: V13 Ch4 (v13.txt:13968-13973); official keyword page gives about 100
contradictions.resolution: The V12 figure is a guess; V13 states a number, but the fan TL may have inflated it (the official keyword says about 100).
contradictions.treatment: F-TEM-005 carries 10,000 (EXPLICIT per the TL) at MEDIUM confidence, with the conflict noted.

contradictions.claimB: V13 Ch1 and V15 Ch1: one hundred
contradictions.resolution: Likely a translation variance; the ~300 'Flying' of V12 are the Blue Numbers' dragon mounts.
contradictions.treatment: F-TEM-003B = 100 Hiryuu; F-TEM-003C = ~300 Blue Numbers dragon riders.

contradictions.description: Forecast arrival of the imperial army
contradictions.claimA: V12 Ch5: ~1,500 km at ~80 km/day, about twenty days
contradictions.claimB: V13 Ch1: expected in about twenty-nine days or more, but slower
contradictions.resolution: Two forecasts at different times; both are overshot by the actual contact (D+0 = 33 days after the war council).

contradictions.claimA: Pre-R5 events: EVT-0115 Veldora annihilates the air corps; EVT-0384 the Empire proposes an armistice; EVT-0397 Veldora leaves citizens without memory of the defeat; EVT-0321 the blockade loses its command
contradictions.claimB: Text: Ultima's Nuclear Flame destroyed the air corps (Gabil was mistaken for Veldora); no armistice proposal exists (Benimaru demanded surrender, refused); citizens had simply never lost a war; Zero restored order

ambiguities.subject: Total size of the invasion army
ambiguities.ambiguity: The fan TL renders the invading army as 'ninety-four thousand' at v13.txt:7057 and 18347.
ambiguities.chosenPlacement: 940,000, stated outright at v13.txt:16208 and v14.txt:1124/4650/10133. Resolved (R5).

ambiguities.subject: The figure 'one hundred thirteen thousand' in V12 Ch4
ambiguities.ambiguity: V12 Ch4 says a force of 'one hundred thirteen thousand' could be sent once the emperor gave the order, immediately after describing legions totalling far more. Readings: (a) 1,130,000 mis-rendered; (b) a first-wave echelon; (c) translation corruption.
ambiguities.chosenPlacement: Excluded from the force database rather than guessed at. Recorded here only.

ambiguities.subject: Clock times across the whole campaign
ambiguities.ambiguity: The corpus contains essentially no clock times. Only relative durations appear (under six seconds, ten minutes, less than an hour, three hours).
ambiguities.chosenPlacement: All hour-and-minute placements are SIMULATION_RECONSTRUCTED. Only the relative durations are carried as EXPLICIT_RELATIVE.

ambiguities.subject: Calendar dates
ambiguities.ambiguity: No in-world calendar date is given for any campaign event.
ambiguities.chosenPlacement: Artificial marker year 9001 used. DATE_BASIS = SIMULATION_RECONSTRUCTED throughout.

ambiguities.subject: Duration of the labyrinth phase
ambiguities.ambiguity: Labyrinth duration. V13 gives entries by day (350,000 / 150,000 / 30,000, v13.txt:9489-9493), raiders meeting on day four (v13.txt:10042), seven days elapsed at the opening of Ch4 (v13.txt:10599), Minitz entering the next day (v13.txt:11917) and Krishna returning two days after he was sent (v13.txt:16289).
ambiguities.chosenPlacement: Labyrinth Raider operation D+1..D+10 (day 1 = D+1 is RECONSTRUCTED; later days CANONICAL_RELATIVE); the camp outside is annihilated on D+11, after dawn (v13.txt:16004).

ambiguities.subject: Strength of Shion's undocumented unit
ambiguities.ambiguity: V12 Ch2 says Shion's unit is of unknown size (guess under 1,000); V13 Ch4 says 10,000.
ambiguities.chosenPlacement: 10,000 carried on F-TEM-005 at MEDIUM confidence (see CON-010).

ambiguities.subject: V15 Chapters 4 and 5 internal structure
ambiguities.ambiguity: Eight Gates and The Truth of the Emperor concern the nature of the imperial throne and skill-level conflict rather than force-on-force battle. Little of it maps onto conventional battlefield state.
ambiguities.chosenPlacement: Recorded as chapter-level events at MEDIUM/LOW confidence. Further atomic breakdown would require modelling non-military developments.

ambiguities.subject: Destination of the Warcraft Legion after the space-time jump
ambiguities.ambiguity: Destination of Velgrynd's Space-Time Connection.
ambiguities.chosenPlacement: Resolved (R5): the Dwargon eastern front, where the airship regiment appears before Gadora and the Magic Beast Division fights (v15.txt:3404-3435, 3618-3620, 8215-8237). MOV-015/MOV-030.

ambiguities.subject: Tempest casualties in the sealed space
ambiguities.ambiguity: Tempest casualties in the sealed space.
ambiguities.chosenPlacement: Resolved (R5): none. The line was a flashback (CON-003). CAS-013 deleted.

ambiguities.subject: Whether the 60,000 ritual sacrifice is part of the 940,000
ambiguities.ambiguity: The Hybrid Legion is a separate legion from the Jura invasion force in V12 Ch4, and the 60,000 blockade the eastern metropolis rather than the Jura front.
ambiguities.chosenPlacement: Treated as SEPARATE from the 940,000. Campaign totals report the two figures distinctly.

ambiguities.subject: Number of imperial prisoners repatriated
ambiguities.ambiguity: Number of imperial prisoners repatriated.
ambiguities.chosenPlacement: About 700,000 (the resurrected soldiers; v14.txt:875, 5757-5795; v16.txt:7992). The number actually marched home is not stated (some wished to stay).

ambiguities.subject: V16 scope boundary
ambiguities.ambiguity: Most of V16 concerns the Feldway and Michael conflict, which is a separate later war rather than part of the Tempest-Eastern Empire War.
ambiguities.chosenPlacement: Only V16 Ch3 (post-war settlement and rebuilding) is extracted. The later conflict is deliberately excluded per scope.

ambiguities.subject: Interval between the Jura campaign and the second phase
ambiguities.ambiguity: Interval between the Jura campaign and the coup night. V14 gives: resurrection day R; Ch1 = R+1 (v14.txt:875); calm three days after the revival (v14.txt:5010); then a Guy/Velzard visit, a next day, an all-night drink with Elmesia, and the next day the long night (v14.txt:12725-12920).
ambiguities.chosenPlacement: Resurrection D+12; long night begins on the evening of D+18 (R+6): the minimum chain of stated day changes. RECONSTRUCTED.

ambiguities.subject: Distribution of the approach march across the interval
ambiguities.ambiguity: The corpus fixes departure, two forecasts, the month mark, the border crossing and the halt, but no intermediate positions or distances along the march.
ambiguities.chosenPlacement: Approach D-32..D-2 by simulation placement; transit.json interpolates linearly between the canonical endpoints (RECONSTRUCTED). No distance is claimed.

ambiguities.subject: Interval between mobilization and the subordinates' gathering
ambiguities.ambiguity: Intervals between the V12 Ch2 order-of-battle meeting, the V12 Ch4 imperial council, Gadora's audience and the V12 Ch5 war council.
ambiguities.chosenPlacement: Ch2 meeting D-43; imperial council D-40; Gadora's audience and return D-34 (two 'several days' passages on the Tempest side); war council D-33. All RECONSTRUCTED; only the narrative order is canonical.

ambiguities.subject: What the reference point for the month and 29-day anchors actually is
ambiguities.ambiguity: V13 Ch1 opens 'a month has passed since the subordinates' gathering met'. Pre-R5 readings took this as the V12 Ch2 office meeting.
ambiguities.chosenPlacement: R5: the gathering is the V12 Ch5 Control Room war council, which opens "today, in this control room, our subordinates gathered" (v12.txt:12108). Placed at D-33; month mark D-3.

ambiguities.subject: The 50-day campaign window is a simulation window, not a canonical duration
ambiguities.ambiguity: No passage states how long the war lasted.
ambiguities.chosenPlacement: The clock D-43..D+31 (75 days) is a SIMULATION WINDOW assembled from the skeleton in AUDIT-PLAN.md. It must never be quoted as a canonical war duration.

ambiguities.subject: One clock for the long night
ambiguities.ambiguity: The Tidu scenes say 'middle of the night' / 'late at night' while Tempest's alarm comes 'after dinner'; the novels give no clock times and no time zones.
ambiguities.chosenPlacement: One simulation clock: the coup night runs D+18 18:00 to D+19 ~03:00 in strict narrative order. Local-time wording is kept in canonicalTime.

ambiguities.subject: Date of the summit and the repatriation
ambiguities.ambiguity: V16: return home and party; next day off; interviews starting in an evening and running on two further 'tomorrow's; summit 'the next day'; Gazel leaves the next morning; repatriation ready within a week, departure soon after.
ambiguities.chosenPlacement: Party D+19, day off D+20, interviews D+20 (evening) to D+22, summit D+23 (morning session; afternoon from 15:00), Gazel leaves D+24, march departs D+31. Day counts after D+19 are CANONICAL_RELATIVE except the last (RECONSTRUCTED).

ambiguities.subject: Halt and first contact
ambiguities.ambiguity: 'Soon after' the month mark the imperial army halts and the infantry marches into the forest; the next narrated scene (Soei's report, the Gazel call, Testarossa's mission, the battle) is one day, on which Gaster's men are still pitching camp.
ambiguities.chosenPlacement: Halt D-2, infantry camp established D-1, first contact D+0. RECONSTRUCTED spacing.
